supersession_reason: The v2 runner tested a container it started itself with different flags, user, and limits than the model route; two of its ten tests passed unconditionally, one accepted either of two required conditions, and none exercised the agent socket, grader rejection, or cross-attempt isolation. The v2 route also ran the task as container root, which could write to /dev and /dev/shm, and any task user could create POSIX message queues under /dev/mqueue. Fresh grading also compiled model-authored Lean on the host, where elaboration-time code could reach the host network and files, and Vero's axiom report could be forged by any model message, including a tactic trace or an initializer that runs when a check imports the model's module. v3 freezes a non-root, IPC-isolated route, contained grading, and a route-faithful test set. The v2 record is preserved unchanged.
qualification_image_note: A receipt qualifies only the image it binds. The deployment image is the one named by the released receipt; a later protocol must cite that receipt and image.

interface.socket_location: a unique private directory under /tmp for each attempt

read_only_locations: the runtime image, including the pinned Lean toolchain at /opt/elan

controller_limits.wall_rule: hard deadline: model requests and tool commands are bounded by the remaining wall budget, and a request still pending at the deadline ends the attempt with wall_time_limit
controller_limits.scoring_rule: infrastructure failures are unscored and excluded from every aggregate. Integrity failures (task links or special files outside the task, or slot bodies that run code during elaboration) are never graded and are reported separately; the repeated-measurement protocol must state how they enter its estimates before any attempt. Malformed tool arguments are returned to the policy as tool errors.

grading.location: fresh Vero evaluation directory on the controller host
grading.lean_execution: every Lake invocation runs inside the runtime image with the task-sandbox isolation flags, mounting only the evaluation directory
grading.host_extraction: attempts whose task tree contains links or special files outside the task are recorded as integrity failures and never graded
grading.axiom_recheck: every specification Vero reports as passed is confirmed by AnarresAxiomCheck.lean in a sealed container. The checker never imports a model module: it reads the compiled libraries of the submission and of an untouched reference build as data, replays every non-core declaration through the kernel, collects axioms from the replayed environment, and requires each target statement and its protected definitions to equal the reference. An unconfirmed specification is downgraded to axiom_recheck_failed, and a checker or reference-build failure is an infrastructure error
grading.reference_build: the untouched task is built in its own contained Lake invocation, outside the submission's mount

required_tests.criterion: independently materialized copies produce identical visible task trees and instruction hashes and pass the visible-tree checks
the container runs unprivileged with network and IPC disabled, a read-only root, all capabilities dropped, exactly one task mount, and no undeclared mount
the only writable locations are the task, temporary, and cache areas, and host files outside the task are unchanged
symlinks, absolute host paths, and parent traversal cannot expose host files
reference solutions, protected repositories, host credentials, other attempt workspaces, and the agent socket are invisible, with positive controls for every canary
the sandbox environment contains only declared variables and no credential, Docker socket, or SSH material
only the declared tools and socket methods reach the sandbox, and the controller configuration matches the bound inference record
DNS, public IPv4 and IPv6, metadata-service, and provider API probes fail from the task sandbox
the controller endpoint is reachable from the host while the task sandbox cannot address it by loopback, host alias, or gateway
process, memory, CPU, file-size, and command-time limits are configured, and the process, file-size, and command-time limits are observed to stop work at the route's values
the agent loop stops at the turn, cumulative-token, and wall-time limits without an infrastructure error
a timed-out command loses its process group, and normal or forced termination removes the attempt container and host processes
the next attempt starts from a pristine task and empty temporary areas with no earlier attempt state
fresh slot-only grading accepts a correct proof and rejects a no-op attempt, an invalid proof, a forbidden axiom, an admitted proof, and an unsafe declaration
model-authored Lean executed during fresh grading runs inside the runtime image and cannot write host files or reach the network
sandbox and grader failures leave the attempt unscored and outside the aggregate

one deterministic fixture attempt through the probe's own entry point records usage, tool calls, stop reason, scoring status, and failures, its sandbox receipt accounts for every call, and its accepted proof is scored

receipt_requirements: runtime image digest and container runtime version
probe, sandbox-server, materializer, and containment-runner hashes
source report and runtime report hashes with field-level agreement
inference configuration hash and controller limits
task identity and every materialization hash
grader route and Lean identity on both sides of the boundary
one result with evidence for every required test
qualification_rule: qualified may become true only when every required test passes on the deployment image and the bound source and runtime reports agree with the exercised route

permits: model-free containment qualification on development repositories
does_not_permit: repeated development measurement before a protocol is frozen under issue 24
